hints.title: Frequency Map Counting Pass
hints.text: Traverse the linked list once to count the frequency of each node value.

hints.title: Storing Value Counts
hints.text: store the value frequencies in a hash map.

hints.title: Dummy Head Filtering Pass
hints.text: perform a second pass with a dummy head pointer, retaining only nodes whose value frequency equals 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two passes: frequency map pass followed by pointer reconstruction pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every node with all subsequent nodes takes O(N^2) quadratic time on large linked lists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-pass hash map frequency counting runs in O(N) time with O(U) space for U distinct values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should create a dummy head and disconnect the final tail pointer properly.
